== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added from the two announcements already cited on the page ([https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072011/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=83 sid=83], 10 April 2008; [https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=87 sid=87], 25 June 2008): the Saturday poll, costs, prizes, expected attendance (Team Ohio and Reidtech), hotels, airport and floor space, Brad Eier's Origins history, and the ''Lantern'' coverage and James Booker's promotion.
=== Missing data ===
* The prize list marks the first-place voucher "Worlds*" and both byes only as "Bye"; the asterisked footnote is not in the capture, and neither announcement says which day the byes were for.
* The ''Lantern'' is called only "the school newspaper"; the announcement does not name the school.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The 10 April 2008 announcement (sid=83), posted by admin_scott, ends with the line "Michael Erisman" under a signature rule, while its background section is credited to event chair Brad Eier. Whether Erisman wrote or only signed the post is not clear, so the article leaves it out.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* The announcement calls James Booker "the master of promotion, the Jackie Moon of swccg"; the article keeps only that he promoted the event.
